question: Can equal rules yield unequal outcomes under different starting distributions?
status_label: Independent research manuscript / preprint draft, not peer-reviewed. EXP-001 to EXP-003 are simulated; EXP-004 uses real data. Groups A and B are abstract groups, never protected groups.

experiments.title: Sensitivity: base rate versus distribution shape
experiments.status: confirmatory, complete (420 of 420 runs ok); simulated; deviation DEC-019
experiments.verdict: H0 rejected; H2 sign reversal (analytically determined, a quantification, not a test); H3 supported (sign); H4 supported (sign) with a disclosed limitation (DEC-019)
notes: Implementation check passed 56 of 60 comparisons; the failures are in cells D-k0.1-pB0.5 and D-k0.5-pB0.2. The owner accepted them as a disclosed limitation on H4, with no rerun (DEC-019, DEC-021). The magnitudes in those two cells are not confirmed at the frozen standard.
All cells share the same 20 seeds, so cells are not independent replications.

assumptions.name: Observed score
assumptions.value: X = Q + e, e ~ N(0, sigma_g^2) independent of Q; sigma_A = 0.5, sigma_B = 0.5 rho

assumptions.name: Capacity and group share
assumptions.value: kappa = 0.30 selected; p_B = 0.5 in group B

assumptions.name: Population size and seeds
assumptions.value: n = 20,000 fitting and 20,000 evaluation per seed; seeds 0 to 19

assumptions.name: Utility
assumptions.value: U = (TP - c FP) / n with cost ratio c = 1

limitations: Simulation: EXP-001 to EXP-003 hold only within the generator (hard cutoff on a latent qualification, additive Gaussian noise, two groups, one score).
Analytic predictability: EXP-001, EXP-002 and EXP-003 H2 were implied before the runs; their confirmatory status adds reproducibility, not discovery.
Implementation check (DEC-019): EXP-003 passed 56 of 60 comparisons; the owner accepted the failures as a disclosed limitation on H4.
Correlated cells: all cells share the same 20 seeds by design.
P1 binning: P1's magnitudes and its PPV-parity result depend on the 20-bin calibration map (JRN-0015).
EXP-004: one simple four-feature logistic score and one non-protected partition of one 1994 extract; a different score could change the gap; intervals cover the split and tie-breaking only.
No protected attributes were used. Nothing can be inferred about protected groups, and the study makes no claim about workers, hours, pay, causes or any real hiring or selection decision.
No universal metric: the EOG is the primary metric for this question only.
Static decisions: no feedback over time.
Literature at abstract level; the search was not systematic.

display_exceptions.supplementary: Per-cell values of the explorer are printed in research/paper/supplementary.md (tables S2, S3 and S5), which the manuscript incorporates by reference, not in the manuscript body. They are checked verbatim against that file.
display_exceptions.group-rate: Group-level true positive rates (TPR_A, TPR_B) are not printed in the manuscript. They are seed means from the same summary tables, shown to two decimals in percent; their difference is the EOG printed in the manuscript and supplementary file.
